summary: Master contract automation and legal technology training to improve drafting, compliance, and contract workflow speed. Build practical CLM tools and roadmaps.
lede: Contract workflow automation organizes drafting, approvals, execution, and renewals into governed digital processes. For legal operations professionals, in-house counsel, contract managers, and procurement leads, this course covers workflow mapping, clause and metadata governance, approval and e-signature routing, and obligation tracking. It also introduces AI-assisted drafting with human oversight and reporting on cycle time, bottlenecks, and exceptions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle the daily reality of contracts, approvals, renewals, and legal technology decisions. It fits both operational staff and leaders who need to standardize contract automation and legal technology practices across legal, procurement, and commercial teams.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, a modern web browser, and enough familiarity with contracts to work through drafting and workflow exercises. Participants should be prepared to review sample NDAs, MSAs, or SOWs and adapt templates to their own operating context.
